[SWS_DM_00426] Assigning a UDS request to an existing Diagnostic Conversation
⌈
If a UDS request is received and there already exists a Diagnostic
Conversation associated to the transmitting Diagnostic Client, then the Diagnostic
Server instance shall assign this UDS request to the same Diagnostic Con-
versation.
⌋
